problem: Empty states for zero rituals and zero badges: resolve('empty state when no rituals exist') returns UNDEFINED (no search hits). The build improvised a ruled statement block plus one action and deliberately omitted any illustration - the move was right but derived, not resolved.
insufficiency: No pack entry defines empty states; consumers get no resolution at all and may guess between notice/field/surfaces styling or invent an illustration, contradicting the imagery posture. Source evidence L-17 (docs/synthesis/leader/decisions.json; refs/sheet.html L-17 card, Gate 2) defines 'Empty state = ruled statement block with one action (outline or red rectangle); no illustration.' It never reached the pack.
reuse_case: Every collection surface can reach zero items (rituals, entries, badges, records) - a system-level pattern that recurs in any data product, well beyond Cadence.
composition_check: The ingredients exist (ruled box = surfaces/notice language; one action = component/action) but the pattern-level rules do not: which vessel, exactly one action, copy register, and the explicit no-illustration rule (L-17 + L-21). Today nothing resolves, so vessel choice and action count are guesswork; the smallest change is one pattern entry, not per-screen solutions.

proposed.title: Empty state (ruled statement, one action)
proposed.source_evidence: decisions.json L-17 (empty); refs/sheet.html L-17; L-21 imagery posture; L-20 voice; guideline/surfaces for the rule treatment

body.structure: ruled statement block - white ground, 2px ink rule (top or frame per guideline/surfaces); terse declarative copy naming the state and the next step (L-20)
body.actions: exactly one action (outline rectangle, or the screen's purpose action); never a cluster of links
body.illustration: none - imagery is story-bound (L-21); absence here is honest, not a gap
body.in_character: editorial: a sentence and one move, no mascots, no cheering

tests: a built empty-state block contains no /illustration element (DOM check)
exactly one interactive action inside the empty-state block (DOM count check)
empty-state copy present and exclamation-free (copy lint)
